The override DEDUPES -- one lodash-es at 4.18.1, no nested copy -- so nothing is shadowed. REMOVE THIS once chevrotain ships a release depending on >=4.18.1. undici@7.29.1 -> 7.30.1: wrangler 4.149's miniflare pins undici 7.29.1 EXACTLY (GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx and seven more, fixed in 7.30.1); the latest miniflare still pins an older 7.x, so npm update cannot reach it.
